caption: A close-range outdoor ground scene is almost entirely obscured by a bright, dense cloud of airborne dust and flying debris. Straw shards, dark flecks, and a pale green blade drift across the washed-out frame while the background stays barely distinguishable. As the haze darkens and then loses opacity, suspended particles continue to move through the field of view. The dark shrubbery and thin twigs behind a patch of dry straw gradually show through the murk. Visibility of the ground increases steadily, revealing scattered green leaves and a slender vertical twig standing on the right. A crumpled red-and-white bag-like object emerges left of center and holds its position as the dust thins. A lingering haze and scattered flecks continue to drift in the air as the cloud settles.
relations: As the dense dust cloud loses opacity, suspended particles drift while background shrubbery and twigs gradually emerge.
The settling haze reveals scattered green leaves and a slender vertical twig standing on the right.
A crumpled red-and-white bag-like object appears left of center and maintains position as visibility increases.
Lingering airborne flecks continue to drift through the field of view as the cloud dissipates.
